description: This file is a server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling HTTP requests, determining request type (bot or browser), and streaming server-side rendered React components.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function that processes incoming HTTP requests, sets CORS headers, determines if the request is from a bot or browser, and directs to appropriate handling functions.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering flow when the request is identified as from a bot, streaming the rendered React component back to the client.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering flow for browser-based requests, streaming the rendered React component back to the client.
